name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.2 Port)
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. A rework of enchantment progression: you can now enchant your gear using enchanted books placed in nearby chiseled bookshelves using a chiseled enchanting table.

custom.chiseled_enchanting_table:port_notes: Unofficial community port to Minecraft 26.2. 1.1.0 layers the whole 26.1.2-line feature set on top of the 26.3-synced baseline: the progression/economy/UI overhaul (three-track 7x5x7 library, Library Resonance, dual-mode XP, yield-aware material curves, Treasure Epiphany with persistent freeze, Depleted Tome / Blank Overwrite, painted UI, bidirectional JEI/REI), the grimoire/cleanse batch (illustrated Arcane Grimoire manual, dual-tab Inscribe/Cleanse console, Cleansing Grit, curse purging), and the 26.3-line 'provenance & live configuration' batch ported here: EnchantmentProvenance (per-level paid-source tracking for fair refunds), MasterTomeWear (wear / keep / one-shot tome consumption with charge lore and depletion), categorized in-game configuration UI with search, sliders and parent/child linkage (/cet config, /cet reload-config, /cet reset-config, Mod Menu entry, table and grimoire entry points), player-specific unlock catalogs pushed every second, 12/32/38 shelf milestones with the cramped-library check, optional line-of-sight shelf filtering, configurable vanilla-table and anvil rules, and a protocol capability channel that refuses mismatched builds. 26.2-specific adaptations: ChatFormatting does not exist on this line, so every styled line uses Style#withColor(ARGB); Minecraft#setScreen/#screen live on Gui (gui.setScreen / gui.screen()); the 26.2 per-block codec, the 26.2 structure-processor API (interface + codec(), registered into BuiltInRegistries.STRUCTURE_PROCESSOR), ChunkAccess#markPosForPostProcessing, the two-argument LivingEntity#drop, the plural conditions[]/functions[] loot schema and the recipe_crafted 'recipe_id' criterion are kept, and the 26.2 GLFW mouse-button numbering is used in the custom screens. Viewers stay pinned to jei-26.2-fabric 30.47.0.239 / RoughlyEnoughItems-api-fabric 26.2.821; Mod Menu is a compile-only shim that is never bundled. See CURRENT_BASELINE.md, docs/reports/SYNC_FROM_26_1_2_SIDE_REPORT.md (sections 6-7) and docs/reports/SYNC_FROM_26_3_SIDE_REPORT.md for the change-by-change mapping and the version adaptations.
